title: 1.5-hour Dolphin Sightseeing Cruise from Tampa
includes: Parking in front of building (parking charges apply) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult

Covid-19 Health operation for our tours. We have lowered the capacity of our vessels from 45 to 15 to allow for social distancing of each group on the boat. Our boats will be sanitized between each departure. ALL guests are required to wear a face covering (nose and mouth) at all times. Boarding will be refused to any guest not wearing a face covering without a refund. We care about your and our staff's health. So Thank You for your cooperation it is appreciated.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Did you know that Tampa Bay is home to over 600 Atlantic Bottle-nose dolphins? On this 1.5-hour cruise, your captain and guides will teach you have to spot dolphins making you an expert by the end. You can choose from morning or afternoon departures to fit your schedule.
